theorems.name: Submission.dorag_ted_planes_limit
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (S : ℕ → Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (a q : ℝ), (∀ j, Module.finrank ℝ (S j) = n) → 0 ≤ q → q ≤ 1 / 4 → (∀ j : ℕ, ∑ i : Fin P, ‖(S (j + 1)).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) - (S j).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))‖ ^ 2 ≤ a * q ^ j) → ∃ S' : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), Module.finrank ℝ S' = n ∧ ∀ j : ℕ, ∑ i : Fin P, ‖S'.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) - (S j).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))‖ ^ 2 ≤ 4 * a * q ^ j
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
